title: Session state lost after widget interaction in 1.64
body:
After upgrading to 1.64.0, st.session_state values set inside a callback disappear on the next rerun. Minimal example:

```python
import streamlit as st
if 'count' not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.count = 0
st.button('inc', on_click=lambda: st.session_state.count += 1)
st.write(st.session_state.count)
```
Environment: Python 3.11, Streamlit 1.64.0, Chrome.
author: reporter
